recipes.name: The Ultimate Burger Topping
ingredients_raw: 0.5 cup light mayonnaise (such as Hellmann's Light®)

steps.text: Cook the bacon in a large, deep skillet over medium-high heat until evenly browned, about 10 minutes; drain on a plate lined with paper towels. Crumble the bacon once cooled enough to handle.

Heat the olive oil in a skillet over medium heat; cook and stir the onion and garlic in the hot oil until translucent, about 5 minutes; transfer to a bowl. Add the crumbled bacon, light mayonnaise, blue cheese, and black pepper to the onion and garlic; stir to combine.

raw_recipe.headline: The Ultimate Burger Topping
raw_recipe.description: If you're a fan of bacon and blue cheese, then this is definitely for you! This is also a great dip for crackers.

review.reviewBody: Wow! Great way to perk up a regular 'ol burger! My husband is a huge fan of bacon and I adore blue cheese so this combination for a burger topper was a must try and it definitely didn't disappoint. Very easy to do and perfect over grilled burgers and I'm sure would be just as good on grilled chicken sandwiches too. I can't wait to try it as a dip for crackers and veggies! Thanks for a great recipe Christina!

This is absolutely delicious! The only change I made was to cook the onion and garlic in a tablespoon of the bacon grease instead of the olive oil. There were no other toppings needed on our burgers. Wow, great recipe, Christina! Thank you for sharing!

Most definitely a 5+ star. The first time I made this I did so 3 different ways. We had company and I'm the only one who eats Bleu Cheese. I made 1 full batch with Bleu Cheese, I made another full batch with Feta cheese and the third batch (recipe scaled down to 1 serving) with shredded Cheddar cheese. Everyone loved their hamburgers with this topping. What to do with the leftover Bleu Cheese topping? Later in the week I spread the leftover Bleu Cheese mixture on the leftover hamburger buns and popped them under the broiler. It melted up so nicely and got a golden brown color. My BC hating husband thought the bread was delicious. I didn't tell him what he was eating! This recipe is so delicious Christina, I've given the recipe out a few times. It will be made again and again and again in this house. Thanks for sharing.

I have to admit this does not look like something I would normally put in my mouth. However I definitely will be making this stuff again. It is so good! I have never been one to follow a recipe exactly. If you are a blue cheese fan don’t change a thing this recipe is perfect. If you are not a blue cheese fan like myself I used feta and added more pepper seasoning to make up for the bite I lost from not using blue cheese. I’m pretty impressed with it

Fantastic on burgers and grilled pork. Forgot to rate a while back. I subbed with what was on hand, so I used precooked bacon crumbles, dried minced onion (no fresh in the house), and left out the saute part. I also used a home made mayo rather than store bought. Let this sit in the fridge for a few hours before dinner and it was great. Can't wait to try this with the caramelized onion and garlic per the recipe. Used Gorgonzola for the blue cheese. Thanks for sharing.

This topping was a big hit with my family. I omitted the olive oil as I didn't think it was necessary. I made half with blue cheese which my husband and I enjoyed. The other half I substituted with cheddar cheese which my kids preferred. Delicious either way!

This is so good on burgers, but it would also be great on a steak, chicken, pork chops, or as a dip! I did add 1 extra slice of bacon, and that was the only change I made! My hat is off to you on this one Christina, great recipe!

Wow, this got rave reviews from the entire family. Very tasty and it also would be great on a baked potato or as a dip. The only thing I changed was to saute the onion and garlic in the bacon drippings instead of olive oil. Definitely will make this again but will have to make more of it. In fact, everyone wanted to just eat it with a spoon!!!

Wow oh wow!!
I made this for my family because the ingredients sound so good and I was so right! It was a HUGE hit! I followed the directions to a T and it was amazing. I took other reviewers advice and chopped up the bacon before hand. This is definitely a keeper! Thanks for submitting!

I made this two night in a row upon request... I also made haystack onion rings (thin sliced onions rings (french fried onions)) for my boyfriend's burger also ... because he loves onions. I didn't have bleu cheese which i was bummed about so i subbed feta and it was awesome... I can't wait to try it with Bleu cheese next time... WHICH WILL BE A WHILE... I think we consumed enough calories for a few days
I loved it. The hubs didn't. You win some, you lose some.
Very delicious, makes burgers 100 times better than they already are, also good with cheddar and blue cheese

It is the BEST Blue Cheese burger topping I have ever made. Rich and tangy and totally delicious on top of a juicy and simply spiced burger. My go to recipe for my family for burger topping. It never disappoints!

Excellent!! So yummy on burgers! Husband & 2 years old son loved it as well!!
We tried it on steaks too, but the bacon was a bit too much with steak, in our opinion.

I want to give this more than 5 stars!!!!!!!!!!!!! This is amazing!

Reviewed this yesterday but wanted to add that all I can think about this morning is another bleu cheese burger. I'm hooked. :)

Well how yummy was this...I could have eaten it with a spoon! I used prepared pepper bacon bits and halved the recipe for just the two of us. We love blue cheese bacon burgers, what a great new twist on an old fave. A definite do-over, thanks for sharing this recipe Christina!
